financial_operation_lease_check.value: (num_nonnulls("financial_operation"."lease_owner", "financial_operation"."lease_token", "financial_operation"."lease_expires_at") = 0 OR (num_nonnulls("financial_operation"."lease_owner", "financial_operation"."lease_token", "financial_operation"."lease_expires_at") = 3 AND length(trim("financial_operation"."lease_owner")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim("financial_operation"."lease_token")) BETWEEN 1 AND 128)) AND ("financial_operation"."state" NOT IN ('CLAIMED', 'PROCESSING') OR num_nonnulls("financial_operation"."lease_owner", "financial_operation"."lease_token", "financial_operation"."lease_expires_at") = 3)
